例句

  1. Some Japanese tourists lack common sense and carry a lot of cash in their back pockets.
    有些日本觀光客缺乏常識，在褲子後面的口袋裡放很多現金。
  2. He lacks experience.
    他缺乏經驗。
  3. This soup lacks salt.
    這碗湯少了鹽。
  4. There is a lack of doctors in this town.
    這個小鎮缺少醫生。
  5. Our team lacks good players this year.
    我們隊今年缺少好的選手。
  6. She doesn't lack money, but she lacks time.
    她不缺錢，但她缺時間。
  7. Ken is lacking in confidence.
    Ken 缺乏自信。
  8. A lot of people visit this park on weekends.
    週末有很多人來這個公園。
  9. I don't have a lot of time today.
    我今天沒有很多時間。
  10. My grandmother grows a lot of vegetables in her garden.
    我奶奶在她的菜園裡種很多蔬菜。
  11. We drank a lot of tea in Taiwan.
    我們在台灣喝了很多茶。
  12. A lot of students take the bus to school.
    很多學生搭公車上學。
  13. Don't carry a lot of cash when you travel.
    旅行的時候不要帶很多現金。
  14. My grandmother has a lot of patience.
    我奶奶很有耐心。
  15. This city lacks parks.
    這個城市缺少公園。
  16. We got a lot of snow last winter.
    我們這裡去年冬天下了很多雪。
  17. We don't have a lot of money, but we are happy.
    我們沒有很多錢，但我們很快樂。
  18. The young team lacked experience, but they played well.
    這支年輕的隊伍缺乏經驗，但他們打得很好。
  19. Some young drivers are lacking in common sense.
    有些年輕駕駛缺乏常識。
  20. Some tourists carry a lot of cash in their wallets.
    有些遊客在錢包裡放很多現金。
  21. Tom lacks money, so he can't go on the school trip.
    Tom 缺錢，所以他不能去校外教學。
  22. A lot of Japanese people carry cash because many shops don't take cards.
    很多日本人帶現金，因為很多店不收卡。
  23. My little brother keeps a lot of candy in his desk.
    我弟弟在他的書桌裡放很多糖果。
  24. There is a lack of water in this area in summer.
    這個地區夏天缺水。
  25. A lot of my friends live in Taichung.
    我很多朋友住在台中。
  26. Some people who lack sleep get angry easily.
    有些睡眠不足的人很容易生氣。
  27. I found a lot of old photos in my father's desk.
    我在我爸爸的書桌裡找到很多舊照片。
  28. Our classroom lacks space for so many students.
    我們教室的空間不夠容納這麼多學生。
  29. We saw a lot of tourists in Kyoto last weekend.
    我們上週末在京都看到很多遊客。
  30. His speech lacked energy.
    他的演講缺乏活力。
